name: Sanimus Slayn
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World

items.name: Phase Cutlass
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

A phase cutlass resembles a traditional curved sword until it's powered. Then its blade morphs into a shimmering void, with a tiny star for each life it ended.

items.name: Broken Tactical Dueling Sword
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

Coming in a variety of styles, these traditional and time-tested weapons have been honed with advanced smithing techniques and modern materials.

defensiveAbilities.name: Lonely Rage
defensiveAbilities.description: Sanimus is an even more aggressive combatant when he's forced to fight alone. When fighting with no active allies, he flies into a rage that gives him an additional reaction at the start of each turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vengeful Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within Sanimus's first range increment uses an action or reaction to heal, grant bonuses, or otherwise assist another creature

Effect Sanimus makes a ranged Strike against the triggering creature.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Auto-Fire
offensiveAbilities.description:
Minigun (60ft Type:cone, analog, automatic, magical, unholy)

Damage (2d10+8) Piercing Damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw)

offensiveAbilities.name: Concussive Feint
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Sanimus is holding his minigun

Effect Sanimus attempts an intimidation|against:perception check against a single target's Perception DC within the first range increment of his minigun. On a success, the target counts as Clumsy 2 against his next area attack before the end of his current turn. On a critical success, the target is clumsy 2 against all of his area attacks until the end of his next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crescent Blast
offensiveAbilities.description: Sanimus twists his minigun while firing it, curving its bullets through the air. He makes a ranged Strike or Auto-Fire attack with his minigun but calculates the point of origin for the attack as though it originated from up to 2 squares outside of his current space on the map, allowing him to fire his weapon around cover and corners.

offensiveAbilities.name: Infuse Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: Sanimus's weapons are infused with his hatred, gaining the magical and unholy traits and dealing spirit damage when he wields them. These weapons deal an additional 1d8 spirit damage to living and undead creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Minigun Training
offensiveAbilities.description: Sanimus has trained for centuries with his minigun and can push his gear beyond what the living can achieve. When using the Auto-Fire action, Sanimus can target all creatures within the first full range increment of his weapon, rather than just half of its range. Additionally, Sanimus can ignore any number of creatures in this area without penalty. Finally, his minigun only needs to be reloaded once per day in a special unholy ritual during his daily preparations.

offensiveAbilities.name: Suppressing Fire
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies that fail their save against Sanimus's Auto-Fire attacks become Suppressed until the start of his next turn.
